name: Contecnica: Landing platform
description: Production marketing and commerce monorepo: FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Next.js, event-driven cache coherence, and container-based deployment.
longDescription: A production monorepo pairing an async FastAPI API with a Next.js public site. Content and catalog data live in PostgreSQL; Redis coordinates cache invalidation so visitors always receive fresh JSON after admin edits. Guest checkout integrates payment and fiscal providers with stock reservation and webhook-driven order state. Schema changes are versioned through migrations. Delivered with Docker Compose, container registry images, and documented staging-to-production promotion.
features: Database-first content model with real-time public-site refresh
Guest cart and checkout with payment webhooks and fiscal integration
Admin commerce and catalog management on the modern frontend
Redis fan-out for coherent cache invalidation
Compose stacks for local, integration, and production-shaped environments
Container registry images with CI validation before publish
Prometheus-friendly operational metrics on critical checkout paths
highlights: Event-driven architecture that avoids stale public content after admin changes
Commerce added without breaking the CMS and API separation
Repeatable container deploys with registry images and integration CI
challenges: Marketing sites with CMS workflows and e-commerce need consistent cache behaviour under load.
solutions: Write-through API, Redis notifications, typed client refetch, and automated integration tests in the delivery pipeline.
security: Separated public and admin API surfaces
Checkout CSRF and rate limiting on sensitive endpoints
Secrets only on deployment targets, never in source control
TLS termination documented for production reverse proxies
